about.description: Mineral Vault provides tokenized access to physical commodities and precious metals through blockchain infrastructure. It enables fractional ownership and efficient settlement of commodity positions.
about.registryInfo: Mineral Vault is a tokenized commodity platform focused on physical mineral / mining-rights tokenization. Issues tokens representing fractional ownership of mineral-rights leases or stored physical mineral inventory.

fees.revenueNotes: Mineral Vault earns origination fees on each tokenized mineral-rights or inventory issuance + ongoing storage / insurance fees on physical holdings.
